answer: Each identity locks 400 POA in a glacier vault that thaws only 10% per week, so exit takes ten weeks. Every week it must broadcast a beacon proof linking its device key and recent work; a missing or reused beacon freezes the next thaw and slashes 15%. Checkpoints are written to a basalt record that cannot be rewritten without redoing the whole chain, letting auditors verify each thaw in order. A second identity costs another 400 POA and another ten-week thaw, so ten fakes lock 4,000 POA for months, while honest identities thaw steadily and keep earning.
